sealed_non_evaluated_holdback.reason: Preserve blindness until official primary byte/page binding closes.

primary_null.name: INDEPENDENT_SITE_CLUSTER_RIGID_TRANSLATION_EXHAUSTIVE
primary_null.rule: Translate every date belonging to a site by one common integer-day offset; choose each site's offset independently; preserve all within-site date gaps exactly.
primary_null.support: For each site, every integer-day shift for which all plus/minus 3-day windows remain completely inside the frozen Palomar study interval.

seasonality_sensitivity_null.name: INDEPENDENT_SITE_CLUSTER_CALENDAR_YEAR_SHIFT_EXHAUSTIVE
seasonality_sensitivity_null.rule: Move each site cluster independently by whole calendar years only, preserving month/day and within-site geometry; include only year offsets for which all plus/minus 3-day windows remain within the study interval.
seasonality_sensitivity_null.purpose: Sensitivity control for seasonal structure in the Palomar observation schedule.

sequential_evidence_contract.cumulative_rule: Report R4 and R4.1 as separate preregistered stages and, if combining evidence, use an explicitly labeled meta-analytic/sequential combination rather than pretending all dates were jointly blinded before R4.

claim_ceiling: R4.1 TESTS WHETHER A SECOND INDEPENDENT SOURCE-FIRST EARTH HOLDOUT HAS MORE PALOMAR OBSERVATION-OPPORTUNITY OVERLAP THAN EXPECTED UNDER FROZEN SCHEDULE NULLS. IT DOES NOT TEST OR ESTABLISH OBJECT IDENTITY OR CAUSATION.
canonical_seal: THE EARTH HOLDOUT AND BOTH NULLS ARE FROZEN BEFORE THE SKY CALENDAR OPENS. HANFORD REMAINS UNOPENED.
